config.notes: Thinking is ALWAYS ON for this model and cannot be disabled — an explicit thinking:{type:"disabled"} returns 400. The adapter requests {"type":"adaptive","display":"summarized"} so the transcript records the model's reasoning summary for the qualitative audit; display controls visibility only and does not change what is billed. The raw chain of thought is never returned by the API. Assistant turns are echoed back verbatim because thinking blocks must be replayed unchanged. REQUIRES 30-DAY DATA RETENTION: an organisation configured for zero data retention gets HTTP 400 on every request regardless of payload.
